) PRIMARY KEY (PartnershipId);

-- Leaf Class: ContractualParty (Inherits from AutonomousAgent)
CREATE TABLE ContractualParties (
  PartyId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  partyName STRING(255),
) PRIMARY KEY (PartyId);

-- Leaf Class: Loan (Inherits from FinancialInstrument)
CREATE TABLE Loans (
  LoanId STRING(36) NOT NULL,

  interestRate NUMERIC,
  lenderPartyId STRING(36) NOT NULL,    -- Loan hasLender ContractualParty Restriction
  borrowerPartyId STRING(36),
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: SignificantCorporateLoan (Amount > 10,000,000.00)
  isSignificantCorporateLoan BOOL AS (loanAmount > 10000000.00) STORED,

  CONSTRAINT FK_Loan_Borrower FOREIGN KEY (borrowerPartyId) REFERENCES ContractualParties (PartyId),
) PRIMARY KEY (LoanId);
